guide.summary: A sugar eater that spends energy making an enzyme that turns starch into sugar.
guide.biology: Some microbes release enzymes outside their bodies to break large food molecules into pieces they can absorb.
guide.rules: Eats sugar only; cannot eat starch directly. When starch is in or beside its cell and it has more than 35 energy, it releases starch enzyme at 0.40 energy per second. The sugar that enzyme makes is free for anyone nearby to eat.
guide.example: Crumbsmiths around a starch patch can feed their Sprinter neighbours as well as themselves.
